study_name: Pilot Validation of Prescribed Scale Adaptation

T01.rule: Sort by original 0.5 mm footprint equivalent diameter, select 10 equally spaced rank indices.

L01.rule: Sort by original 0.5 mm footprint equivalent diameter, select 10 equally spaced rank indices.

limitations: This pilot tests dataset-construction feasibility only, not LightGBM accuracy or real-mine volume accuracy.
The scale factor is a geometric-similarity assumption because external OBJ physical units remain unverified.
No model was trained and no mine-site point cloud was processed.

decision.next_action: Build the full scaled 10 mm dataset with this frozen scale factor only.
